scope: One real-browser structural-tiny measurement through the existing stdio connector and perf-browser driver, plus a separate operator JS-heap probe. This is a localhost sample, not a product-wide performance or physical accuracy claim. No product source change was made.

gmshAssets.note: The first attempt failed before the job because public/gmsh was empty; node scripts/copy-cad.mjs populated it. This is environment setup, not a product-source change.

loadedInput.name: Axial bar reference sample
loadedInput.operatorDisclaimer: The perf driver does not verify the loaded physics; the operator loaded the axial bar reference sample and confirmed structural kind, E=1e9 Pa, two conditions and one mesh before pairing.

auxiliaryWarmupNotPartOfPerfWindow.why: Before the successful driver run, the operator ran one ordinary GUI solve to warm the WASM/Gmsh path after the failed attempts.
auxiliaryWarmupNotPartOfPerfWindow.mesh: 171 nodes / 428 tetrahedra; 4000.00 mm3; quality 0.632; below 0.2: 0 elements

warm.note: One warm run only; the warm total was not lower than cold, so no speedup is claimed.

cancel.latencyScope: cancelJob request to observed terminal plus executionSettled through connector polling; includes 50 ms poll granularity

memory.source: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize bytes (non-standard, coarse; JS heap scope)

uasm.reason: No measureUserAgentSpecificMemory sample was produced inside the case window even though the page reported crossOriginIsolated true. UASM is not merged into the JS-heap series.

rules: Do not add uasm and jsHeap together.
peakBytesSampled is a periodic-sample maximum, not total process or peak RAM.

runHistory.cause: public/gmsh was empty in the dedicated worktree

runHistory.error: Browser disconnected during the structural-tiny cold run
runHistory.observed: The page stayed alive; its connector poll later reported ERR_PROXY_CONNECTION_FAILED to the MCP port. No assertion detail or product stack trace was captured.

runHistory.prerequisite: One ordinary GUI solve warmed WASM/Gmsh, then a fresh pairing with inspect+analyze scopes

commands.note: Run with the existing stdio connector; pairing code was entered through the local connection UI and is not recorded.

unconfirmed: The browser is the OpenCode desktop Electron/Chromium build, not branded Google Chrome.
Only the structural-tiny case was measured, with repeats=1. There is no multi-run distribution, and the single warm run is not a stable baseline.
UASM was unavailable; only the coarse JS-heap series is reported.
The measured timings cover localhost connector polling and include the 50 ms poll interval; they are not solver-only timings.
GPU/WebGPU, MFEM, thermal, acoustic, channel-flow, public HTTPS, OS download and full-suite/post-push CI were not measured in this unit.
The second attempt's disconnect cause was not proven, and it is not attributed to product code.
Parent PERF1 remains incomplete; this is one limited localhost case.
